meta.description: Cross-layer medallion pipeline expectations. Validate that each layer contract is upheld after a pipeline run. Run against all three tables after a full Bronze→Silver→Gold cycle.
meta.when_to_run: After each complete pipeline run (all three layers). Fail the pipeline trigger if any expectation fails.

meta.notes: Bronze metadata column — must exist. Absence means add_bronze_metadata() was not called.
Source file provenance — required for Bronze lineage audit.
Batch ID must always be populated (0 for non-streaming).
Replace 'business_key' with your actual id_col. Silver must have a business key.
Silver deduplication must produce exactly one row per business_key. Failure indicates deduplicate_silver() was not applied.
Silver must not be empty after a Bronze batch. Empty Silver means all records were quarantined or transform_fn dropped everything.
Replace 'report_date' with your Gold partition column. All Gold rows must have a reporting date.
Replace 'metric_value' with your primary KPI column. Null Gold metrics break dashboards.
KPI values must be non-negative. Adjust or remove if your domain has negative metrics (e.g., returns).
